numbering_check.method: per-residue comparison of MOS residue index vs _atom_site.label_seq_id vs _atom_site.auth_seq_id from the raw mmCIF
numbering_check.result: identity mapping for all 246 residues; zero mismatches; no insertion codes; no alternate conformers

direction_and_units.direction: Negative ddG_pred = mutation predicted to STRENGTHEN binding; positive = predicted to WEAKEN binding.
direction_evidence: score_ddg = -ddG_pred exactly in all 4674 rows (max abs deviation 0.0).
The 'rank' column is a pure monotone rescaling of ddG_pred: Spearman(rank, ddG_pred) = 1.0 (most negative ddG_pred -> rank 0.00021, most positive -> rank 1.0).
Direction is inferred from the output table's internal arithmetic. It is NOT stated in any platform documentation.
direction_and_units.unit_statement: The Binding Affinity Mutation Effect schema and the output CSV header specify no unit for ddG_pred. Treated as an unlabelled relative free-energy score. No kcal/mol or other unit is asserted anywhere in this deliverable.
direction_and_units.source: raw/bindmut/schema_binding_affinity_mutation_effect.json (documents neither direction nor unit); output header raw/bindmut/affinity_scores.csv
